visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video begins at a bustling night market where a young man with glasses and a black vest holds a skewer featuring a large green bell pepper coated in a thick, glossy sugar syrup. He smiles and speaks directly into his handheld camera. The background is filled with bright neon lights, a colorful ferris wheel, and various game stalls containing plush toys. (2) A close-up shot transitions to the food stall counter, displaying an array of fruits like strawberries and grapes on sticks, all dipped in red sugar coating. Unexpectedly, yellow and green bell peppers are also present in the display. The vendor's hands are briefly visible as they arrange the skewered items on the counter under bright studio-style stall lighting. (3) The main character takes a forceful bite of the sugar-coated green pepper, his face contorting slightly as he crunches through the hard exterior. He holds the half-eaten pepper toward the lens, revealing the raw green interior and seeds. He continues to chew and gesture while describing the experience, with his hands frequently entering the frame to point at the food. (4) The scene shifts as he walks through the market while continuing his taste test. The camera captures him from various eye-level angles in a selfie perspective. He reacts to off-screen comments with laughter and expressive facial movements, showing the progress of eating the large pepper until it is nearly finished, all against a background of moving passers-by.

The creator uses a fast-paced vlog style to capture the novelty of the snack and his genuine reaction to the unusual flavor combination of sweet syrup and bitter raw vegetable.
